body:
This was the first trip Ive taken in about 7 months due to an experience with the same substance that fucked me up to the point that I couldnt smoke weed properly without feeling horrible. I decided to take this experience again cause I had a good trip on 35 grams of powdered San Pedro about 3 weeks before this and I was also with a girl who I am in a complicated open relationship with but I am very intellectually and mentally linked to during the trip. This trip was probably around my 39th trip on 1P-LSD AND 48TH on an acid like substance although (only my third dropping with another person) I have taken other drugs including two trips on mescaline, and mandy a few times, plus other experiences.
I started the day by smoking hash with my friend from around 8 in the morning playing video games and chilling out, then I drove him home and picked up my friend Im sort of in an open relationship with at about 6:30 to 7:00pm at which point we went to go pick up some food mainly fruit and veg and fruit juice and what not, and grabbed some cigarettes so that we wouldnt have to roll, then we headed back to mine smoked a hash joint and ate some dinner it was around 9pm at this point. We chilled watching TV till about 11:30pm at which point we took a tab each consisting of 100µg, for me it started to kick in in half an hour but Ive become quite attuned at noticing the slight changes in my surroundings while taking acid, my parents being away allowed me to fully relax and explore my house to a greater extent and fully submerge myself in my trip a lot more without being constrained by the presence of my parents. We set up some grateful dead on the TV and started a fire in the fireplace and set up a mattress in the middle of the main room and got down to dancing as soon as the drugs began to take hold, earlier that day I found my harmonica so decided to play it, which I strongly urge anyone who has one to use it on acid cause it sounds amazing and it taught me how to play, and became a big part of my tripping experience.
We danced for hours and hours and laughed out asses off, I havent laughed that much since my early acid trips, we had some particularly funny experiences when we tried to have sex around the peak due to the distortions, I did manage to eat her out during the peak and she gave me a BJ and later on the come down while we were still tripping we managed to have sex which was amazing as it felt like we became one during stages of it and every touch felt amplified. Walking around my house during the trip was a beautiful experience, as my parents have unknowingly created the perfect place to trip, basically, the choice of décor is a lot of antiques and Persian rugs and patterned wallpaper and lots of intricate paintings, one, in particular, is an Indonesian painting with two lovers intertwined which is very psychedelic in nature when sober, but at one point in the trip it appeared to look like 100 different paintings stacked together to make one. The bathroom at my house has two mirrors that if you stand in between makes the effect of endless copys of yourself, along with the lighting that is mainly purple and the patterned floor made it difficult to leave once you go in and close the door.
At around 3 in the morning we ventured outside with a torch [flashlight] to explore my garden for a bit while still dark, the patterns being quite intense at this stage it was difficult to make out the grass we were stepping on but everything was very beautiful, every light was on in the house casting an alluring warm orange glow.
At about 7am after a shower we went for a walk in the early morning light to a small lake near my house, when we got there the water seemed like a sheet of glass perfectly reflecting everything in shimmering golden light there was a heron that gracefully soared across its surface, we then took a walk through a nearby garden where the owners have a small stream and a tunnel made of bamboo which was stunning to walk through, the sounds of the birds was amplified creating a nice melody to our sleepless minds.
Acid and psychedelics for me have always been a source of intellectual and spiritual enlightenment and also creative inspiration, so I decided to try and write poetry during my trip as I have never tried writing during a trip and I was beyond happy with the outcome. During the come down we talked about different dimensions, time travel, previous trips and ate some beautiful food. After the walk we watched the Matrix and then slept for the rest of the day, she left on the day after.
On a whole this was one of my favourite trips, and the colours, patterns and visuals seen throughout it where truly the essence of beauty.
